name: oxlint-plugin-audit
description: Oxlint rules extracted from the version-locked stack audit prompts: deprecated APIs, migration residue and security footguns across Next.js/React, the data layer, AI SDK/payment integrations and the JS toolchain.

scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:fixtures && pnpm check:skill-assets
scripts.test: for f in src/*/rules/*.test.ts; do echo "  $f" && tsx "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.test:fixtures: oxlint -c oxlintrc.audit.json --deny-warnings fixtures > /dev/null 2>&1 && echo 'fixtures produced no findings — the integration fixture has regressed' && exit 1 || echo 'fixtures still trip the plugins'
